class.name: LocalizedText
class.brief_description: A translated text with inserted values that keeps bound control properties up to date.

method.name: bind
method.description: Binds [param property] of [param target] to this text: sets the metadata [code]localized_<property>[/code] of [param target] to this resource and sets the property to [method get_text] now and whenever the text changes. A [LocalizedText] bound before to the same property is unbound. The channel of the binding is the translation domain ([method Object.get_translation_domain]) of [param target] at this moment, unless [member channel] is set.

method.name: get_text
method.description: Returns the translated text with its placeholders filled, in the locale of [member channel] (or of [code]interface[/code] when [member channel] is empty). Called on the main thread, it also makes [signal text_changed] fire when the text changes later.

method.name: is_bound
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param property] of [param target] is bound to this text.

method.name: unbind
method.description: Removes the binding of [param property] of [param target] and its metadata. The property keeps its last text. When it was the last binding of the node, the node's [member Node.auto_translate_mode] is restored.

members.member: Values for the placeholders of the text, by name. They win over the values of [TextInsertionServer]. Assign a new dictionary (or the same one again) after changing it, so bound properties refresh.

The locale channel of the text ([code]interface[/code], [code]audio[/code], [code]subtitles[/code] or a custom one, see [method TranslationServer.set_locale_for]). Empty: each binding follows the translation domain ([method Object.get_translation_domain]) of its node (the main domain is [code]interface[/code]), and [method get_text] uses [code]interface[/code].

The name of the value that selects the plural form, for example [code]enemy.count[/code]. It is read from [member args], then from [method TextInsertionServer.get_value]; a change of that value refreshes the text. Empty: no plural.
The translation key, looked up with [method TextLocalizationServer.translate]. A key without a translation is used as the text (its placeholders are filled too).

When bound properties are refreshed. Use [constant REFRESH_EVERY_FRAME] for HUD texts whose values come from [method TextInsertionServer.register_provider] providers without [method TextInsertionServer.notify_changed].

signal.name: text_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the text of the resource's own channel (see [method get_text]) changed after a refresh. Only checked while the signal has connections and the text is bound or was read with [method get_text].

constants.constant: Refreshes when the locale of the channel, a used placeholder value, a catalog or the resource changes. The default.
Also refreshes every frame ([signal SceneTree.process_frame]); a property is still only set when its text changed.
